checks: Dismissal, redraw, configuration and save/load never generate another visit
A new finite queue takes time and shows its precise affordable cost
Earned visit bank is capped and cannot be spent by a dismissal
Expired waiting visitors leave automatically without a negative review
Legacy flow adoption preserves the finite existing audience and grants no historic credit
Insufficient waiting funds reject atomically and a repeated waiting transaction is idempotent
Debt never advances an unattended waiting loop and a corrupt future arrival is rejected
New contracts preserve their continuous curve through save/load and settle only once
The new payment curve is continuous and an explicit hard violation refunds the ticket
Previously accepted contracts retain their old full-payment threshold even with new evidence
Full, partial and refunded tickets remain distinct in the session statement
Arrival quote accounts for a visitor whose agreed departure is at the next tick
A second genuinely purchased room increases future flow without granting visitors on configuration
Waiting during a running session stops on a future event and preserves its manual assignments
